state.name: Tag Selector — Open
state.purpose: Select existing tags or create a new tag while editing task tags.
visualRules: Use the global bottomSheet pattern from design-system.json.
Tags do not have individual icons.
Tag identity is represented by its text label.
Selected tags use the global teal selected state.
Use a check icon only to communicate selection.
Do not show Suggested or Recent sections unless those product features are explicitly introduced.
Do not duplicate the Create new tag action.
Controls inside the sheet must reuse global design-system tokens.

reference.description: Approved open state of the task tag selector.
